en.t: The rain showed no sign of letting up.
Although it was already June, there was still a slight chill in the air,

units.source_text: 昏暗的灯光下，被门板围起的五铺席宽的储藏室显得特别荒凉。

en.t: and under the dim light, the storage room, about five mats wide and enclosed by door panels, looked especially desolate.

units.source_text: 这就是我前住房，或许不久我就会从这里被撵走。

en.t: This was my former lodging, and perhaps before long I would be driven out of it.
There was no decoration of any kind in the room,

units.source_text: 变了色的角席的黑边已经破损、歪扭，露出硬线来了。

en.t: and the black edging of the discolored mats was already torn and warped, exposing the stiff threads beneath.

units.source_text: 进入黑暗的房间，拧开电灯时，我的脚趾经常被破席拴住，

en.t: When I entered the dark room and switched on the light, my toes were often caught in the torn matting,

units.source_text: 可我也没有去修补一下，

en.t: but I never bothered to repair it,

units.source_text: 我的生活热情与铺席这类事是毫不相关的。

en.t: for my passion for life had nothing at all to do with things like floor mats.
